title: Chicken and pepper stir-fry
summary: Chicken and pepper stir-fry is a chinese dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and yellow peppers, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Slice skinless chicken breast fillets and yellow peppers before the pan is hot. Chicken and pepper stir-fry is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry skinless chicken breast fillets until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add yellow peppers and broccoli, return skinless chicken breast fillets, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Chicken and pepper stir-fry before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
